steps.what: Inspect the roofing job and measure dimensions, details and access conditions
Choose materials, waste allowances and labour assumptions for the measured roofing work
Calculate estimated material quantities and labour hours from the checked assumptions
Review estimated quantities, labour and exclusions against the specific roof before release

tasks.design: Configure a protected calculation sheet in {SPREADSHEET} or the existing estimating system before building custom code. The roofer retains measurement and job-specific allowances, while formulas calculate material quantities and labour totals for a final human check against the actual roof.
tasks.previous_blocker: The same area, coverage and labour arithmetic may be repeated for each estimate.
tasks.enabler_now: Validated formulas can reuse captured measurements and explicit allowances without a model.
tasks.still_hard: Hidden damage, awkward details, weather exposure and access conditions that change labour needs.
tasks.human_edge: Recognising where nominal coverage and productivity assumptions do not fit the site.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated arithmetic where it remains manual; site judgement and estimate responsibility stay unchanged.

reach.task: Compare planned and actual roofing resources
reach.learn: Separate measurement error from productivity and scope changes

evidence.claim: Area, linear-detail, material-coverage and labour-hour calculations can use deterministic formulas once checked inputs are supplied; this is model knowledge, not a digest-documented roofing result.
The20-hour removable arithmetic fraction and5-hour upkeep are provisional task scenarios; there is no measured local saving.

assumptions: Boundary is resource estimation, not a customer price quotation, purchasing or roof installation. Site inspection, travel within the estimate visit and measurement retain45 hours. No drone or remote measurement replaces the visit.

Roofer s1 produces roof plane dimensions, pitch or measured surface area with method, linear details, openings, condition and access observations. s2 produces material coverage and lap units from checked specifications, chosen waste allowance, labour rate assumption, access adjustment and scope exclusions in its full20 hours. Capture, unit conversion and correction are counted there; no free structured geometry or productivity rating is assumed.

s3 consumes only the checked measurements and allowances produced by s1/s2. Missing dimensions, mixed units or unusual details cause manual calculation and explicit exclusions rather than inferred values. Formula results are reviewed in s4's full15 hours.
Test existing native estimating formulas first. The scenario applies only to an existing repeated manual calculation fraction; already automatic calculations earn no new labour saving.

Incremental5 focal hours cover specification/coverage updates, formula sample checks and comparison with actual jobs. No new ongoing work is transferred to another role; feedback comparisons are included in that allowance.
unknowns: Existing estimating tools and actual arithmetic effort
Available measurement quality and validated coverage assumptions
research_questions: How much resource-estimate effort is repeated arithmetic after measurements and allowances are chosen?
Do formula estimates remain conservative on complex roof details without reducing site inspection?

already_counted.description: Material and labour assumption selection plus final estimate review

incremental.description: Coverage updates, formula checks and actual-job comparison

approvals.approved_version: Exact roof measurements, scope, materials, waste allowances, labour assumptions, totals and exclusions; changes void roofer approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R80 gives gross20 and net15 after5 upkeep. High assumes20 hours of currently manual arithmetic are automated from complete checked inputs; low is manual calculation fallback plus5 upkeep. Site45, assumption selection20 and final review15 remain unchanged. E1 scenario.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Roofers may spend less time recalculating resource totals while retaining site inspection and judgement about materials and labour.
reach: Compare estimate assumptions with construction estimators using actual job outcomes
role.ambitious_version: A roofer who produces transparent resource estimates tied to measured conditions and explicit uncertainty.
